name: Xintiao Dujia Wu
source:
In this game you play as the heroine, which suddenly becomes the temporary owner of a guest house after having lost her memories.

From the day you become the guest house owner, you will begin your encounters with 4 very attractive guys - and they all seem to have some connection to your childhood! Interact with them to piece together your lost memories.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895950/Doki_Doki_House/]Steam[/url]]
